title: Pendulums are the most common artifact in Egypt

tellings.quote: If you go to Egypt and you dig in the soil there, the most artifacts that they find under the ground in Egypt are pendulums.

plain: A man named Chris Bledsoe, who says UFOs come to him, told the podcast host Jesse Michels something he credits to a man named Robert Gilbert. According to Bledsoe, when people dig in the soil of Egypt, the objects they find most often are pendulums, weights hung on a string. He raises it because it would suggest ancient Egyptians had a special use for pendulums, perhaps for sensing or contacting something unseen.
